title: Platform Engineer
summary: Platform engineers build the shared internal platform that other developers use to build, test and deploy their code, usually on Kubernetes and a public cloud. They sit in a platform or infrastructure team and treat the product teams as their customers, giving them ready-made 'golden paths' (standard, pre-approved ways to ship a service).
dailyDuties: Upgrade and patch shared Kubernetes clusters
Write Terraform modules that product teams reuse
Add a new service template to the developer portal
Fix a broken deploy pipeline for another team
Review pull requests to platform repositories
Answer developer questions and update platform docs
